# KeXinMaterials (客信新材料) — Full LLM Data
## About
KeXinMaterials (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. — source factory of protective cases, established 2014. 13,000㎡ facility, 60+ machines, 20+ patents, 150+ SKUs. Specializing in plastic tool boxes, protective cases, safety cases, waterproof cases — OEM/ODM custom. Exported to USA, UK, Germany, Canada, Japan, Russia, Philippines, India, HK/TW, Middle East.

Company: KeXinMaterials (Guangdong) Co., Ltd.
Email: kexin@beeaa.com
Phone: +86 13590555309

## All FAQs
Q: Is KeXinMaterials a factory or a trading company?
A: KeXinMaterials (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. is a source factory with an 18,000㎡ facility. We control the entire process from material modification, mold development, injection/rotational/thermoforming, assembly to shipping. Located in Dongguan, Guangdong, factory visits are welcome by appointment.

Q: What is your MOQ?
A: Standard SKUs have an MOQ of 50-100pcs; custom mold MOQ is 300pcs. Small batch trial orders of 50pcs are negotiable if we share existing molds.

Q: What is the lead time?
A: Standard SKUs ship within 3 days from stock. Custom orders 20-30 days. Custom mold 35-45 days. Sea shipping to destination port 30-40 days (EXW / FOB Shenzhen or Ningbo). Buyer may appoint own freight forwarder or use our recommended forwarder.

Q: Which payment methods are supported?
A: We support T/T 30%/70%, L/C at sight, Letter of Credit, PayPal (small orders), and Western Union. Large orders can use staged payment. New clients typically start with T/T 30%/70%.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Email kexin@beeaa.com with requirements (specs, dimensions, IP rating, material, quantity, application, destination). Formal PDF + Excel quote within 12 hours. For urgent requests, WhatsApp +86 13590555309.

Q: Do you provide samples?
A: Standard SKU samples are free (shipping paid by client, 5-7 working days via DHL/FedEx). Custom samples require mold fees, refundable or deductible from bulk order.

Q: What certifications do you have?
A: ISO9001 QMS, CE, RoHS, REACH, UN38.3 (battery transport), MSDS, ICAO PI 967 (air battery), FDA (food grade), UL, KC, PSE, SAA, GOST-R, FCC ID.

Q: Do you offer OEM/ODM services?
A: Full OEM/ODM: 3D structural design, mold development, injection/rotomolding/thermoforming, surface finishing (silk-screen, hot stamping, laser engraving, UV spray), neutral packaging, client logo. No strict mold MOQ (small orders can share molds).

Q: What does IP67 mean? How deep can it go?
A: IP67 is the international protection rating: 6 = dust-tight, 7 = immersion in 1m water for 30 minutes without ingress. Our IP67 cases pass IEC 60529. For deeper underwater use, IP68 (5-30m) is available.

Q: How to choose explosion-proof rating?
A: Common ratings: Ex ib IIB T4 (IIB gas, T4 temp ≤135°C), Ex d IIB T4 (flameproof), Ex e IIB (increased safety). Li-battery transport typically uses Ex ib IIB T4. Contact kexin@beeaa.com for certified solutions.

Q: What tests does MIL-STD-810G cover?
A: MIL-STD-810G covers 28 environmental tests: drop, vibration, shock, humid heat, salt fog, fungus, solar radiation, low pressure, high/low temp, rain, sand dust, explosive atmosphere, etc. Our products pass 15 core tests; full suite available.

Q: What is the resistance of ESD boxes?
A: Three grades: conductive 10^3-10^5 Ω (fast static discharge), static dissipative 10^6-10^9 Ω (industry standard), insulative 10^10-10^12 Ω (anti-triboelectric). For electronics transport, 10^6-10^9 Ω is recommended.

Q: How are small / medium / large / extra large defined?
A: Size classification (outer longest side): Small ≤300mm, Medium 300-500mm, Large 500-800mm, Extra Large 800-1200mm, Oversize >1200mm. Same product at different sizes has 3-5x volume difference.

Q: What is the difference between long and deep cases?
A: Long cases (e.g., elongated toolbox, rifle case) suit long items. Deep cases (deeper interior) suit voluminous but short items. Both can be combined for custom orders.

Q: How to get the wholesale price list?
A: Send your business license + purchase requirements (specs, quantity, destination) to kexin@beeaa.com with subject 'Wholesale Quote'. Bilingual PDF + Excel quote within 12 hours. Tiered pricing for 500+ pcs.

Q: What certifications are needed for US exports?
A: Basic: CE / RoHS / FCC (electrical). Special: UL (power, battery), FDA (food/medical), DOT (transport), CPSIA (children), UN38.3 (battery), FCC ID (wireless). We provide full documentation.

Q: What certifications are needed for EU exports?
A: CE (mandatory, multiple directives), REACH (chemicals), RoHS 2.0 (hazardous substances), PPE (personal protection), EN 60529 (IP), EN 62262 (IK), UN3373 (biological). One-stop CE service available.

Q: Is GCC certification required for Middle East markets?
A: Saudi Arabia: SABER mandatory (PCOC + SCOC). UAE: ECAS / EQM. Kuwait: KUCAS. Qatar: G-Mark. We offer one-stop GCC certification + SABER regulatory training.

Q: Sea freight to the US — how long and how much?
A: FOB Shenzhen → US West Coast (LA/Long Beach) sea 18-25 days, East Coast (NY) 28-35 days. 100kg+ FCL reference rate USD 0.8-1.5/kg (West Coast) / USD 1.2-2.0/kg (East Coast). Tariff, customs, and last-mile delivery are handled by the buyer (or buyer's appointed broker/freight forwarder).

Q: What to note for exporting to Russia?
A: GOST-R certification, Russian manual + labels, EAC mark (EAEU) required. Currently recommend re-export via Kazakhstan / Belarus, or use EAEU channels. We offer Russian localization.

Q: How to choose a protective case?
A: 5-step selection: ① Define items to protect (weight, size, sensitivity) ② Evaluate environment (IP rating, temperature, vibration) ③ Confirm industry certifications (food/medical/battery/military) ④ Commercial intent (wholesale/custom/export) ⑤ Budget (PP/ABS/GF/rotomold price 2-3x difference).

Q: How much is a protective case?
A: Reference retail prices: PP small USD 12-22, PP medium USD 22-45, ABS medium USD 30-60, GF-PP medium USD 50-90, rotomold large USD 90-220. Custom adds 30-80%. Wholesale 500+ pcs 30% off.

Q: What is the customization process?
A: 5-step customization: ① Requirements (48h reply, 2-3 clarification rounds) ② 3D design + quote (3 working days, 2 revision rounds) ③ Sample + sign-off (7-10 days, 1 rework) ④ Production (30 days, IQC + FQC) ⑤ Shipping (sea / air / courier, docs included).

Q: Can MOQ be lower?
A: Standard SKUs: 50 pcs MOQ with wholesale pricing. Custom: 300 pcs MOQ; 50 pcs negotiable if sharing existing molds (no dedicated tooling). All small batches can rush in 15 days (20% rush fee).
